description: Stablecoin supply per day for up to 3650 days. With stablecoin (a symbol such as USDT, a CoinGecko id or DefiLlama's id): its supply in peg units and USD, price and supply on chain if given. Without: every stablecoin's supply together (USD, USD pegs at par), overall or on chain. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: A chain name as DefiLlama writes it, case-insensitive (Ethereum, Base, Tron).

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

stablecoin.description: A symbol (USDT), CoinGecko id (tether) or DefiLlama id; empty for all.

name: stablecoin_history
title: Stablecoin supply history
